BEFORE WE GET STARTED

A little clarity.
A good beginning.

Can you redesign my existing website?+

Yes. I work on both new websites and existing stores. Share your current URL and what you want to improve so we can discuss the right approach.

What should I send with my first message?+

Your website URL, a short introduction to your business, your goals, and a couple of references you like. If you’re starting from scratch, just tell me about the idea.

Will my website work on mobile?+

Yes. Responsive layouts, clear navigation, and an easy mobile experience are part of the design and development approach.

How do we decide on scope and timing?+

We’ll discuss your pages, products, features, and priorities through Fiverr before agreeing on the project. That keeps expectations clear from the start.
